the acyl glucoronides studied in this work are not substrates for hCES, but they are reversible inhibitors of the hCESs, with the exception of the valproate- and CGP47292-β-glucuronides.
the acyl glucronides studied in this work were not substrates for either hCES1 or hCES2, but were inhibitors of hCES1 with a selectivity for hCES2.
the acyl glucurinides studied do not appear to be substrates of either hCES1 or hCES2.
